en.name: Shutong
en.ability: On your first night, choose a player (not yourself). Except first night, if they are targeted by an evil player's ability, you die that night.

zh.name: 书童
zh.ability: 在你的首个夜晚，你要选择除你以外的一名玩家：除首个夜晚以外，当他被邪恶玩家的能力选择或影响时，你会在当晚死亡。
